bias.en: Pullback · back above the 10-day, capped by the 200-day
bias.zh: 回调 · 重新站上 10 日均线，受制于 200 日均线

read.en: Tesla edged up 0.1% on Nov 17 to $380.11, trading $374.15–382.84 on light volume (0.56x the 20-day average). It reclaimed the 10-day ($378.3) and is above the 100-day ($366.6), but below the 30-day ($381.3, rising), 200-day ($382.3, falling) and 5-day ($387.7). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 12 ($344.51), and RSI is 49.6.
read.zh: 特斯拉 11月17日微涨 0.1%，收于 $380.11，盘中区间 $374.15–382.84，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.56 倍）。股价重新站上 10 日均线（$378.3），位于 100 日均线（$366.6）上方，但低于 30 日（$381.3，上行）、200 日（$382.3，下行）和 5 日均线（$387.7）。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴上方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月12日起看多（$344.51），RSI 为 49.6。

read.en: The close reclaimed the 10-day, now support; the $374.15 low undercut the Nov 4 and 16 lows ($375.5–375.6) intraday, but the close held above them. Resistance is $381.3–382.8 (30-day, 200-day, Nov 17 high), then $387.7–389.8 ($388 cap, 5-day, Nov 16 high) and $397.5–401.2. Support is $378–378.3 (Nov 9 close, 10-day), then $374.2–375.6 and $366.6–370.4 (100-day, Nov 10 low). A close above $382.8 would target $388–390; below $374.2, $366.6–370.4.

r.en: $388 cap since March; 5-day average $387.7; Oct 9 high $388.56; Nov 16 high $389.80
Nov 12 close $397.45; Nov 3 close $398.50; Nov 12 high $401.22
